picks.headline: Hypothalamic volume and cell-type changes in ageing and Alzheimer's disease
picks.blurb: HypoAD pairs MRI from 458 people with single-nucleus RNA sequencing of 614,403 nuclei, reporting that metabolism- and circadian-regulating hypothalamic subregions are particularly vulnerable in ageing and Alzheimer's.

picks.headline: Conservation of the tumour microenvironment across organs and species
picks.blurb: Screening thousands of public single-cell datasets, the authors report shared stromal and immune programs across 42 cancer types in over 2,000 human and mouse tumours, released as an interactive atlas.

picks.headline: At-home microbiome tests are taking off. Can they be trusted?
picks.blurb: A Nature reporter sent stool samples to two direct-to-consumer companies to compare what each one told her about her gut microbiome.

picks.headline: Alcohol use reduces the efficacy of anti-PD1 immunotherapy by disrupting antitumor immunity
picks.blurb: In mouse models of lung and bladder cancer, moderate-to-heavy ethanol intake cut checkpoint-inhibitor benefit by about half, and a patient lung cancer cohort showed a similar association.

picks.headline: Innate immune memory of past hepatic injury promotes ischemic cardiac inflammation
picks.blurb: Liver-derived palmitic acid and AP-1-dependent epigenetic reprogramming of myeloid progenitors and cardiac macrophages are proposed to carry an inflammatory memory that may affect recovery after a heart attack.

picks.headline: Isomorphic Labs announces Series C investment round
picks.blurb: The AI drug-design company raised $5 billion, co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, to scale its proprietary drug design engine and therapeutic candidate pipeline.
